mapper.select: select * from test_plan where requirement_number = #{requirementNumber} limit 1
select * from test_plan where id = #{id} limit 1

select id, system_key as systemKey, system_name as systemName, project_id as projectId, node_id as nodeId, principal_id as principalId, enabled, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from requirement_system_mapping where enabled = 1 and (system_key = #{systemKey} or system_name = #{systemKey}) order by case when system_key = #{systemKey} then 0 else 1 end limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into test_plan ( id, workspace_id, `name`, `status`, create_time, update_time, creator, project_id, execution_times, automatic_status_update, repeat_case, node_id, node_path, requirement_number, requirement_doc_url, requirement_system_name, requirement_sync_event_time, int_stage, requirement_approval_status, requirement_approval_comment, requirement_approval_time ) values ( #{plan.id}, #{plan.workspaceId}, #{plan.name}, #{plan.status}, #{plan.createTime}, #{plan.updateTime}, #{plan.creator}, #{plan.projectId}, #{plan.executionTimes}, #{plan.automaticStatusUpdate}, #{plan.repeatCase}, #{plan.nodeId}, #{plan.nodePath}, #{plan.requirementNumber}, #{plan.requirementDocUrl}, #{plan.requirementSystemName}, #{plan.requirementSyncEventTime}, #{plan.intStage}, #{plan.requirementApprovalStatus}, #{plan.requirementApprovalComment}, #{plan.requirementApprovalTime} )
mapper.update: update test_plan set `name` = coalesce(#{plan.name}, `name`), requirement_doc_url = coalesce(#{plan.requirementDocUrl}, requirement_doc_url), requirement_system_name = coalesce(#{plan.requirementSystemName}, requirement_system_name), requirement_sync_event_time = #{plan.requirementSyncEventTime}, int_stage = coalesce(#{plan.intStage}, int_stage), update_time = #{plan.updateTime} where id = #{plan.id}

update test_plan set `status` = 'Cancelled', int_stage = 'CANCELLED', actual_start_time = null, actual_end_time = null, requirement_sync_event_time = #{eventTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}

update test_plan set requirement_approval_status = 'SUBMITTED', requirement_approval_comment = null, requirement_approval_time = null, int_stage = 'TEST_PLAN', update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}

update test_plan set requirement_approval_status = #{approvalStatus}, requirement_approval_comment = #{approvalComment}, requirement_approval_time = #{approvalTime}, int_stage = #{intStage}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}
